checkpoints: unchanged G5 epoch-50 selected Standard and Improved
fusion: uniform raw-logit mean, unchanged from P2
replay: all 14 Improved InstanceNorm input means and biased variances captured on the same case's native full volume
mechanism_gate: R=(replay_farFP-native_sliding_farFP)/(full_farFP-native_sliding_farFP); R>=0.5 in >=3/4 cases plus a directional median-margin return toward full on the same reference error voxels
component_filter_diagnostic_only: Body 6-connected component <100 mm3 AND <1% largest predicted Body component; reassign best non-Body logit
restrictions: no training, GT-free normalization statistics/filter/inference windows, no Test arrays/results, no parameter sweep, no checkpoint or historical metric overwrite
budget: one A100-test job, 10 minutes maximum; inspect partial output before any rerun
